_comment: TENANT FACTS. This is the only file in the toolkit permitted to contain a
domain name, a server name, or an organisation's internal vocabulary.
Everything else reads from here. If a tenant name appears in a .ps1 file,
that is a bug -- Test-Toolkit checks for it.
Engineer preferences (paths, browser profiles) live in Settings.json, not
here. This file is the same on every machine at a tenant; that one is not.
_capabilities: What this tenant HAS. Not what is reachable right now -- the console probes for that separately, and the disagreement between the two is itself useful.
_directories: One entry per AD forest/domain this tenant uses. A tenant with a single domain has one entry. Two entries is not special -- it is just two entries. The old build hardcoded exactly two and named them, which is why it only ever fitted one tenant.
_pim: Portal deep links. Defaults are the generic Azure PIM blades; override only if a tenant uses a different entry point.
_licencegroups: On-prem groups whose membership IS the licence. Empty when OnPremAD is false.
